name: fiadocheck-postman-sv
description: Newman runner + reporte Obsidian para pruebas SV

scripts.test:sv: newman run FiadoCheck-SV-Pruebas.postman_collection.json -e FiadoCheck-SV-Pruebas.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json,htmlextra --reporter-json-export reports/newman-results.json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/postman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "FiadoCheck SV — Postman"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:sv && npm run test:auth && npm run test:sesion && npm run test:scoring && npm run test:recomendacion
scripts.docs:sv: npm run test:sv && npm run report:obsidian
